verdict.rationale: Marketing copy explicitly states Justworks lets companies 'Pay employees and contractors in multiple states or countries, and vendors anywhere in the US,' confirming both W-2 and 1099 payment support on one platform, and payroll help docs describe running payroll and checking payroll accuracy. However, there is no detailed documentation walking through the actual contractor payment workflow (e.g., 1099 setup, contractor invoicing/payment cadence, combined pay run mechanics) comparable to the depth given for employee payroll, benefits, and PTO. Missing for 10: dedicated contractor payment workflow docs, evidence of a single unified pay run covering both employee and contractor payments, and independent/hands-on corroboration.
